data.title: Onchain analyst links $18.4 million in Robinhood Chain memecoin extractions to single rug-pull operation
data.summary_raw: The creators of 10 Pons V2 launches exempted a set of wallets from Pons' anti-sniping tax; those wallets went on to buy most of each token's supply, per onchain data.

data.title: ‘It’s really not just a blockchain anymore’: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s path to 2030
data.summary_raw: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin said Ethereum is "really not just a blockchain anymore" and laid out how its design will change by 2030 in a post.

data.title: Bitcoin ETFs turn positive for 2026 with $2.4 billion weekly inflow, their largest since October
data.summary_raw: The inflows pushed bitcoin ETFs' year-to-date net flows back above zero, after the funds sat roughly $5.8 billion in the red just two months ago.

data.title: Kalshi loses appeal over Ohio and Tennessee sports betting laws, widening circuit split
data.summary_raw: A federal appeals court ruled on Friday that Kalshi has not adequately shown its sports event contracts are swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act.
